title: gnaphalium lavandulifolium
intro: Gnaphalium lavandulifolium, commonly known as Lavender Cotton or White cudweed, is a small shrub-like plant that belongs to the daisy family. This plant is known for its anti-inflammatory properties and is used to relieve various health issues, including digestive problems and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Gnaphalium lavandulifolium include acting as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, which can help protect against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
